name: competition-ai-skill
title_zh: 12 个竞赛专用技能，从读题到答辩一条龙
tagline_zh: 竞赛季最怕的不是题难，是流程琐碎。这套技能把读题、建模、写报告、做 PPT、模拟答辩全包了，省下时间多跑两轮实验。
tagline_en: Competition crunch? This pack covers reading briefs, modeling, reports, slides, and mock defenses—so you can.
why_zh: 不是零散工具，是按竞赛节奏编排的完整工作流。每个技能都吃透一类环节，衔接处不留空档。
why_en: Not scattered tools—a workflow tuned to competition rhythm. Each skill masters one phase, with no gaps between steps. More.
limit_zh: 只覆盖通用竞赛流程，不针对具体学科（如数学建模、编程赛）的专用解法；不含数据预处理和结果可视化；产出到答辩稿为止。
limit_en: Covers generic competition flow only, not subject-specific methods (e.g., math modeling, coding contests). No data cleaning or visualization. Ends.

install.note: clone 下来，挑你要的那件复制进 ~/.claude/skills/。这是一个合集，没有「装它」这个动作。

title_en: 12 competition skills: from reading the brief to defending.
